source: Inference removes gradient and optimizer-state traffic, but it introduces its own regimes. Prefill processes many tokens at once. Autoregressive decode retains KV state across steps, and at small batch sizes may have limited reuse of large weight matrices per generated token.
zh: 推理消除了梯度和优化器状态流量，但它引入了自己的机制。 Prefill 一次处理多个令牌。自回归解码跨步骤保留 KV 状态，并且在小批量大小下，每个生成的令牌对大权重矩阵的重用可能有限。
